8.4.1.4 EthIf_WriteMii
[SWS_EthIf_91240] Definition of API function EthIf_WriteMii ⌈
Service Name
EthIf_WriteMii
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthIf_WriteMii (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
uint8 TrcvIdx,
uint8 RegIdx,
uint16 RegVal
)
Service ID [hex]
0xa0
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different CtrlIdxs. Non reentrant for the same CtrlIdx.
CtrlIdx
Index of the controller.
TrcvIdx
Index of the transceiver on the SMI.
RegIdx
Index of the transceiver register on the SMI.
Parameters (in)
RegVal
Value to be written into the indexed register.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Service accepted
E_NOT_OK: Service denied
Description
Writes a transceiver register.
Available via
EthIf.h
⌋
[SWS_EthIf_00707] Forwarding a call of EthIf_WriteMii to Eth_WriteMii ⌈The func-
tion EthIf_WriteMii shall forward the call to function <EthDrv>_WriteMii of the
corresponding Ethernet Controller Driver EthIfPhysControllerIdx.⌋
